caption: The video captures a high-elevation view over a thick sea of clouds at twilight, with a silhouetted mountain ridge tracing the left horizon and a small dark peak rising near the center. A narrow band of orange, pink, and yellow glow sits along the horizon, fading upward into deep blue sky streaked with wispy cirrus and downward into the rolling cloud sea. Dark vegetation silhouettes line the bottom edge. The composition remains essentially steady throughout, with the cloud forms and ridgeline holding their positions. The horizon glow, luminous from the start, continues to brighten and widen only very slightly as time passes. This marks a gradual ongoing change rather than a new event.
